Edge hold soft snow: Doesn't feel grabby in soft snow, unlike some disrupted sidecut boards [37] 164. Dampening: Not as damp as Algorhythm but sufficient for all-day riding in all conditions [37] 165. Base glide: "Pretty good but nothing exceptional" [37] 166. Stability at speed: Handles speed well — users report stable at over 40mph [33] 168. Turning: Turns very nice and quick; turny sidecut; very stable carving [33] 169. Buttering/pressing: Takes some effort to press nose and tail; easier after break-in (~12-14 rides) [48][33] 170. Switch riding: Capable switch but feels more comfortable riding in preferred stance [38] 171. Float in powder: Board floats well with 19mm setback; can get 2.25" back from center when set all the way back [49] 172. Forgiving feel: "Very forgiving but stable ride that all ability levels can appreciate" [37] 173. Tracking: "Tracks super well one footing or flat basing and it's easy to skid a turn" [37] 174. Topsheet scratching: Black topsheet scratches easily — white material underneath exposed; looks a season old after ~10 rides [33] 175. Topsheet chip resistance: Topsheet doesn't chip easily despite scratch susceptibility (Roll-In Construction helps) [33] 176.
